development, and bring a proactive, solution-oriented mindset to every challenge.You’ll play an important role in:- preparing and reviewing risk assessments for offshore electrical work- supporting offshore electrical environment- developing, implementing, and improving maintenance plans for offshore electrical installations- coordinating multiple employers involved in offshore electrical activities- planning, organising, delivering, and documenting electrical safety training- implementing, strengthening, and regularly reviewing the Wind Turbine Safety Rules (WTSR) and Orsted Electrical Safety Rules (OESR)- assuming designated roles within the Safe Systems of Work, such as Authorising Engineer, Authorising Officer, or Training Mentor- auditing work processes before regulations- demonstrate technical leadership competence- offer switching experience in high-voltage environments above 20 kV- communicate confidently in both English and German at B2 level or higher-
